title: DeleteOpening Command
description: Remove each selected opening (marker, frame, and record) and rebuild each host wall once from its path. No filler plate. Id omitted uses the current selection, including two or more opening markers or frames. One id removes that opening. Refuses forsk:kind=existing or layer X-EXIST. A failed rebuild restores the openings and leaves the wall.

id.description: Opening marker GUID. Omit to use the current selection.
